# Verify we have required globals from previous steps
print('liked_song_ids exists:', 'liked_song_ids' in globals(), 'len:', len(globals().get('liked_song_ids', [])))
print('spotify_access_token exists:', 'spotify_access_token' in globals(), 'token set:', bool(globals().get('spotify_access_token', None)))

# 1) Fetch current song
current = apis.spotify.show_current_song(access_token=spotify_access_token)
print('current_song:', current)
current_song_id = current.get('song_id')

# 2) Determine whether we need to move
if current_song_id in liked_song_ids:
    print('Current song is already liked. No previous navigation needed.')
    reached_song_id = current_song_id
    reached_title = current.get('title')
    reached_album_title = current.get('album_title')
else:
    # 3) Fetch queue once for step bound / target determination
    queue = apis.spotify.show_song_queue(access_token=spotify_access_token)
    print('queue_count:', len(queue))
    # Find current index in the returned queue order
    current_indices = [i for i, item in enumerate(queue) if item.get('is_current')]
    print('current_indices:', current_indices)
    if not current_indices:
        # Fallback: match by song_id
        current_indices = [i for i, item in enumerate(queue) if item.get('song_id') == current_song_id]
        print('fallback current_indices by song_id:', current_indices)
    cur_i = current_indices[0] if current_indices else 0

    # 4) Compute target: first liked song when moving backwards in the queue cycle
    n = len(queue)
    target_i = None
    target_song_id = None
    target_title = None
    target_album_title = None
    steps_needed = None

    for step in range(1, n+1):
        i = (cur_i - step) % n
        sid = queue[i].get('song_id')
        if sid in liked_song_ids:
            target_i = i
            target_song_id = sid
            target_title = queue[i].get('title')
            target_album_title = queue[i].get('album_title')
            steps_needed = step
            break

    print('target_song_id:', target_song_id, 'steps_needed:', steps_needed, 'target_title:', target_title)

    if steps_needed is None:
        # No liked song found in current queue snapshot; still follow instruction cautiously with a bounded loop.
        max_steps = n
        steps_needed = n
        target_song_id = None
        target_title = None
        target_album_title = None
        print('No liked song found in current queue snapshot; will attempt up to max_steps:', max_steps)

    # 5) Navigate using previous_song until hit liked or reach bound
    reached_song_id = None
    reached_title = None
    reached_album_title = None

    for k in range(steps_needed):
        prev = apis.spotify.previous_song(access_token=spotify_access_token)
        reached_song_id = prev.get('song_id')
        print('prev_step', k+1, 'response:', prev)
        # If we've reached a liked song, stop
        if reached_song_id in liked_song_ids:
            break

    # If we stopped before reaching liked song due to bound, we leave reached_song_id as-is.

    # Fetch details for reached song once (for logging)
    # We use show_song_queue to infer title for the reached song without per-song calls.
    queue2 = apis.spotify.show_song_queue(access_token=spotify_access_token)
    # Find current in queue2
    cur2 = [item for item in queue2 if item.get('is_current')]
    if cur2:
        reached_title = cur2[0].get('title')
        reached_album_title = cur2[0].get('album_title')
    else:
        # fallback: match by song_id
        for item in queue2:
            if item.get('song_id') == reached_song_id:
                reached_title = item.get('title')
                reached_album_title = item.get('album_title')
                break

print('REACHED:', {'song_id': reached_song_id, 'title': reached_title, 'album_title': reached_album_title, 'is_liked': reached_song_id in liked_song_ids})
